title: Gemma 4 26B joins the text API
summary:
Gemma 4 26B joins the text API, image dimensions get strict, and Nova Reel videos are back online.

Added Gemma 4 26B via DeepInfra. It comes with a massive 262k context window, multimodal support, and tool use. Send it a book, see what happens.

Image generation now strictly respects your requested width and height—we ripped out a legacy pre-scaling step that was silently upscaling small requests. Also, Nova Reel video generation is back online after we resolved a compatibility spat between AWS Bedrock and Cloudflare Workers.

OAuth redirects are now more forgiving of trailing slashes and query states. We also patched deny redirects to stay local on validation failure, and updated the dashboard to explain the developer markup system inline so you don't have to hunt through docs.

highlights.title: Gemma 4 26B
highlights.text: The new 26B parameter Gemma model is now live on the text API. It brings multimodal support, tool use, and a 262k context window for when you really need to paste that entire codebase. [View models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models)

highlights.title: Command Line Canvas
highlights.text: Because leaving the terminal is overrated. Generate AI images directly from your command line with the new PollImage CLI tool. [Try it](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pollimage)

highlights.title: Madlisten
highlights.text: The hive is cooking. A new community-built recipe browsing application joins the showcase. [Try it](https://madlisten.dk/)

highlights.title: QR Codes for Tiny Humans
highlights.text: Generate and print custom QR-enabled learning cards for screen-free toddler interaction. [Try it](https://toddler-read.netlify.app/)
